page_title: VAL 3-0 GET | Valencia v Getafe 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Substitution. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ramon Terrats walks off.
85' The attendance is 43357.
83' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
83' Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' Here is a change. Jose Gaya is going off and Carlos Corberan gives the last tactical orders to Jesus Vazquez (Valencia).
79' Carlos Corberan is forced to make a change. Pepelu (Valencia) is unable to continue due to injury, Enzo Barrenechea comes on.
79' The referee signals a substitution. Allan Nyom (Getafe) is brought on as a substitute for Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez.
78' The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
78' Getafe can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
76' The referee gives a yellow card to Cesar Tarrega (Valencia) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
74' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
72' Javi Guerra (Valencia) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
70' Andre Almeida (Valencia) looks very unsteady on his feet after that head injury. Safety first, so he’s coming off and Carlos Corberan has decided that Ivan Jaime is the man to take his place.
69' Jose Bordalas Jimenez decides to make a substitution. Peter Federico will be replaced by Ismael Bekhoucha (Getafe).
69' Substitution. Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) on for Alvaro Rodriguez.
68' Luis Milla (Getafe) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
67' Andre Almeida (Valencia) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
66' Adrian Cordero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Rafa Mir (Valencia). That's a free kick to Getafe.
62' Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Soria intercepts the ball.
58' The referee allows time for a substitution. Luis Rioja will be replaced by Fran Perez (Valencia).
58' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Mouctar Diakhaby (Valencia) will replace Dimitri Foulquier.
58' Substitution. Rafa Mir (Valencia) in, Diego Lopez out.
57' Jose Bordalas Jimenez has decided to substitute Juan Bernat and he is replaced by Coba da Costa (Getafe).
57' Substitution. Omar Alderete makes way for Juan Berrocal Gonzalez (Getafe).
56' Hugo Duro (Valencia) wasted a great chance as he climbed high to connect with a cross from the free kick inside the penalty area. He produced a header which went wide of the left by a whisker.
55' Juan Bernat (Getafe) makes a slide tackle, but referee Adrian Cordero blows for a foul. Valencia win a free kick.
50' David Soria (Getafe) goes into the referee's book. Yellow card.
50' That's a clear yellow card. Diego Lopez (Valencia) goes into the book.
49' Diego Rico (Getafe) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
49' Getafe take a short corner kick.
48' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Peter Federico (Getafe) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick.
48' Diego Lopez (Valencia) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Adrian Cordero no option but to blow his whistle.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+6' The end of the first half.
45+3' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) beats the defender to the ball in the box and shoots, but the ball flashes over the bar.
45+1' The corner is swung in but Getafe can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
45' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
45' A brilliant cross into the box finds Peter Federico (Getafe), who directs his header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper shows all his agility and makes an astonishing save.
42' Valencia failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
39' Jose Gaya (Valencia) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot low towards the middle of the goal. However, David Soria anticipates the shot and makes an easy save.
37' 3 - 0 Goal! Hugo Duro (Valencia) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for David Soria to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom left corner.
37' Hugo Duro (Valencia) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
35' Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.

34' Adrian Cordero blows the whistle, Domingos Duarte (Getafe) is penalised for a foul. PENALTY to Valencia! Almost the entire opposition team is gathered around the referee and complaining. However, the decision has been made and it's final.
34' David Soria (Getafe) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

33' Andre Almeida (Valencia) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but David Soria shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
33' Jose Gaya (Valencia) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
31' Juan Bernat (Getafe) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Adrian Cordero blows for a foul.
30' Valencia enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
26' Diego Rico (Getafe) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
26' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
23' Javi Guerra (Valencia) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. David Soria sees the ball late but does well to stop it going inside the right post.
18' 2 - 0 Goal! Diego Lopez (Valencia) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past David Soria. He makes it 2:0.
18' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Pepelu (Valencia) takes it short.
18' Andre Almeida (Valencia) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Valencia force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
16' Ramon Terrats (Getafe) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Giorgi Mamardashvili comes off the line to clear the ball away.
13' Getafe earn a corner.
13' Omar Alderete (Getafe) fires the ball from the free kick, directing it towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper stretches to punch the ball away. What an excellent save.
12' Referee Adrian Cordero sees the trip by Pepelu (Valencia) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Getafe earn a free kick.
8' 1 - 0 Goal! Pepelu (Valencia) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past David Soria into the bottom left corner.
8' Pepelu (Valencia) is going to take the penalty!
7' Omar Alderete (Getafe) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
7' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle for a foul after Omar Alderete (Getafe) hacks down one of his opponents. It's a penalty to Valencia! Let's see who's going to take it.
4' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
4' Adrian Cordero blows his whistle. Javi Guerra (Valencia) commits a foul after dangerous play. Getafe have a free kick.
2' Juan Bernat (Getafe) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
2' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out at last! Valencia will take the kick-off.
